In Sam Keen's "Fire in the Belly", he incorporates a mixture of traditional religious myths and folklore, personal experience, and the concepts of Jung and Freud to explore his understanding of masculinity and the condition of the contemporary man. He includes some interesting thoughts on the socialization of boys by their mothers, and the psychological development of boys into men. A good text to read in conjunction with Iron John: A Book about Men.
